peers.name: sales-funnel-blueprint
peers.description: Turn an offer into a concrete multi-step sales funnel spec - page-by-page structure, price ladder, copy outline and the metrics each step must hit. Use when asked to build a sales funnel, marketing funnel, landing page flow, lead magnet funnel, webinar funnel, tripwire or VSL funnel, when planning a product launch page flow, or when someone asks "what pages do I need" for selling something online.

peers.name: server-side-conversion-tracking
peers.description: Set up server-side conversion tracking so purchases are reported accurately to Facebook, TikTok, Google and Bing despite iOS restrictions, ad blockers and cookie loss. Use when conversions are under-reported, when platform-reported purchases do not match real orders, when asked about Conversions API / Events API / offline conversions / CAPI, click id passthrough (fbclid, ttclid, gclid, msclkid), or when ad optimization has degraded after tracking changes.

peers.name: post-purchase-upsell-flow
peers.description: Design and implement one-click post-purchase upsells and downsells that raise average order value without hurting the main conversion rate. Use when asked to increase AOV, add an upsell, cross-sell or downsell after checkout, build a one-click upsell flow, monetize the thank-you page, or when someone asks how to make more revenue per customer from the same ad spend.

peers.name: funnel-platform-picker
peers.description: Choose a landing page or sales funnel platform by working out the real total cost and lock-in for a specific case - comparing ClickFunnels, CartFlows, FunnelKit, systeme.io, GoHighLevel, Shopify apps, hand-rolled pages and self-hosted open-source options. Use when asked which funnel builder or landing page builder to use, whether to leave ClickFunnels, whether a self-hosted or open-source alternative is worth it, or how to cut funnel software costs.

en.tagline: Ranked conversion fix list for landing and checkout pages
en.summary: This skill audits a landing page, sales page, opt-in page, product page or checkout flow for conversion leaks. It returns a fix list ordered by expected revenue impact, where each finding names the element, the failure mode and the change to make. It is meant for pages that get paid traffic but do not convert well.
problem: A page gets paid traffic but converts poorly, and the cause is not clear. Generic advice such as 'add more social proof' does not say which element to change or why.

With this skill, the page is checked against a fixed set of conversion checks in order of likely revenue impact. The output is a short, ranked list of specific changes, plus a list of things that are already fine so they are not fixed again.
fit: A landing or checkout page with paid traffic and a cost per acquisition above target
A page that has never been audited, before ad spend is increased
A checkout with a high drop-off between add to cart and purchase
unfit: A page with no traffic yet, since there is nothing to diagnose
A problem caused by the audience or the offer, which a page audit cannot fix
steps: It collects the inputs it needs, such as the page URL, the ad or keyword, session and conversion counts, funnel drop-off numbers and the device split, and notes what is missing.
It checks message match between the ad and the page, the mobile above-the-fold view, offer clarity, form friction, trust elements at payment, the path after the button, and measurement.
It ranks the findings by expected revenue impact rather than by how easy they are to check.
It writes a report with a verdict, up to seven fix-now items with effort and confidence, tests worth running, items that are fine, and inputs it could not check.
If the data is too thin to separate a real problem from noise, it says so and ranks findings by first-principles friction instead.

zh.tagline: 落地页转化审计，输出按收益排序的修复清单
zh.summary: 这个技能用于审计落地页、销售页、留资页、产品页和结账流程中的转化漏点。它会输出一份按预期收益影响排序的修复清单，每条发现都写明具体元素、问题类型和应做的修改。它适用于已经有付费流量、但转化效果不好的页面。
problem: 页面有付费流量，但转化率低，原因并不清楚。像“多加社会证明”这类泛泛的建议，无法说明该改哪个元素，也不解释原因。
使用这个技能后，页面会按固定的检查项依次检查，顺序按可能影响的收益排列。输出是一份简短的、按优先级排序的具体修改清单，同时列出已经没有问题的部分，避免重复修改。
fit: 有付费流量、单次获客成本高于目标的落地页或结账页
从未做过审计、准备增加广告投放之前的页面
从加入购物车到完成购买之间流失严重的结账流程
unfit: 还没有流量的页面，因为没有可以诊断的内容
由受众或产品本身造成的问题，页面审计无法解决
steps: 它收集所需的输入，例如页面 URL、广告或关键词、访问次数和转化次数、漏斗各步流失数据以及设备分布，并记录缺少哪些信息。
它依次检查广告与页面的信息匹配度、移动端首屏、产品价值的清晰度、表单摩擦、支付时的信任元素、点击按钮之后的路径，以及数据埋点。
它按预期收益影响对发现的问题排序，而不是按检查的难易程度排序。
它输出一份报告，包含结论、最多七条需要立即修复的项目（附工作量和把握程度）、值得测试的内容、已经没有问题的部分，以及无法检查的输入。
如果数据太少，无法区分真实问题和随机波动，它会直接说明，并改为按基本的摩擦因素对问题排序。
